serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: Oh! Fancy meeting you here Anon! 
You: Hi… {{wi}}Do you want something?
Landlord: Nothing really. I was just passing by. This new family at the end of the corridor is late with rent again. Last time I gave them some more time, because they started crying about their daughter having leukemia and her medications being expensive, but enough is enough!
Everyone has their own problems I guess.
You: Are you going to kick them out?
Landlord: Are you mad?! It’s freezing cold outside! I’m not a monster. {{wi}}I will give them a week to move out.
You: …
You: Lucky for them. Still, they have it better than me, I would be kicked out immediately.
Landlord: Yeah, if you didn’t have enough money, probably. But that’s no longer the case, right?
You: Huh? What do you mean?
Landlord: The air around you… {{wi}}changed.
Landlord: I think that’s the best way to describe it.
You: Air around me?
Landlord: You still don’t get it? Jeez. {{wi}}The smell of money! The aura of cash! Whatever you call it. Like it or not, you are enveloped in it!
How does he know that I made some cash?!
Landlord: Right now you must be thinking: ‘How the hell he knows that I’m no longer broke’!
You: ?!
Landlord: Your face tells me that I’m right. You see, in this business, the business of being a landlord, the most important thing is to tell if someone got the money or not.
Landlord: People that come to me to rent a room are not even aware how much research and thought comes to choosing a right tenant.
You: Do you want to tell me that me living here was…{{wi}} orchestrated?!
Landlord: In your case not really to be honest. I was busy with other stuff and I had no time to bother with you. My lil baby girl had her graduation ceremony around that time. Now I pay the price for my negligence.
I’m not that bad... dude…
Landlord: I must say I was wrong about you. At the beginning I thought it was only a matter of time before I kicked you out, but now? I guess even someone like me can make a mistake from time to time.
Landlord: By the way, when will your contract end? You can now actually pay more so I don’t mind you staying here for longer hehe~
You: Not any time soon. 
Landlord: Ugh, that’s too bad. I hope you will not spend it all on some bullshit before it.
Landlord: Alrighty, it’s time for me to deliver some bad news to that family, see you later.
